user.title: New IR remote
user.description: Choose the IR emitter used to send the buttons and the IR receiver used for learning.

abort.kein_sender: No IR emitter (infrared entity) found. Set up e.g. ESPHome with `infrared: platform: ir_rf_proxy` first.

anlernen.title: Learn button
anlernen.description: Enter the button name, click **Submit**, then **briefly** press the button on the remote, pointed at the IR receiver.

code_eingeben.title: Enter NEC code
code_eingeben.description: Create a button from a known NEC code, without the original remote. Values in hex: 8-bit (e.g. address `00`, command `40`, the inverted byte is added) or 16-bit as in ESPHome (e.g. `FF00` / `BF40`).

progress.warten: Now press “{name}” on the remote … (waiting {sekunden} seconds)

abort.kein_signal: No IR signal received. Hold the remote closer to the receiver and try again.
abort.empfaenger_fehlt: The IR receiver is not available.
